question: In which North Eastern City will you find The Christ Church which is regarded as the oldest Church of North East India?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Guwahati__"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Christ Church Guwahati** positioned close to **Nehru Park** in **Panbazar **is the** oldest Church**, now no longer simply of Guwahati but the complete **northeastern** region.
 
• It is undoubtedly the biggest and most popular name in the league of churches in **Guwahati.** 
 
• Its production began in **1844 **and it became consecrated in **1850.**
 
• The church witnessed effective earthquakes one in **1854** and the alternative in **1897** while a few components of the construction have been **damaged.**
 
• The church was maintained by the diocese of **Kolkata.**
 
• People go right here to experience the serene and stunning splendor and to wait for the fascinating Sunday** mass services, Bible research classes ****and Confirmation classes, ** conducted over the weekends. 
 
• In **2017**, the Christ Church got a major facelift.
